books.title: The Three Hostages
books.author: John Buchan
books.summary: A former man-of-adventure is coaxed out of comfortable retirement and into danger as he aids in the rescue of three hostages.

books.title: The Survivors of the Chancellor
books.author: Jules Verne
books.summary: A record of the ill-fated voyage of the Chancellor as told by one of the passengers.

books.title: Pointed Roofs
books.author: Dorothy M. Richardson
books.summary: Seventeen-year-old Miriam Henderson is sent to Germany to teach English at a finishing school in Hanover.

books.title: Queen Victoria
books.author: Lytton Strachey
books.summary: A sardonic and generally unflattering biography of Victoria Alexandrina, Queen of England.

books.title: Through the Looking-Glass
books.author: Lewis Carroll
books.summary: In a follow-up to her adventures in Wonderland, Alice finds herself in a mirror image of the whimsical land where she becomes a queen in her own right.

books.title: Fred Gross Stories
books.author: Ring Lardner
books.summary: A police detective attempts to live the American dream in the Chicago suburbs.

books.title: Saint Joan
books.author: George Bernard Shaw
books.summary: Joan of Arc’s life story is retold, from her early life, to her campaigns, and beyond.

books.title: The Little White Bird
books.author: J. M. Barrie
books.summary: A series of adventures in London, including those of the narrator and a little boy named David, and Peter Pan.

books.title: Notes from Underground
books.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
books.summary: A man living alone in St. Petersburg writes memoirs describing his alienation from modern society.

books.title: The King in Yellow
books.author: Robert W. Chambers
books.summary: Ten short stories of madness, hauntings, romance, and art.

books.title: A Personal Record
books.author: Joseph Conrad
books.summary: Conrad recounts his childhood in Poland, his sailing experiences, and the work on his debut novel.

books.title: The Sword of Damocles
books.author: Anna Katharine Green
books.summary: A successful New York businessman, burdened with a dark secret in his past, is threatened with exposure and ruin.

books.title: Legends of Vancouver
books.author: E. Pauline Johnson
books.summary: E. Pauline Johnson’s collection of legends and myths of the Squamish people.

books.title: The Theory of Moral Sentiments
books.author: Adam Smith
books.summary: Adam Smith assesses the sources of human morality and the role of human sympathies in judging the propriety of our actions and behaviors.

books.title: Poetry
books.author: Sarah Louisa Forten Purvis
books.summary: A collection of poems by Sarah Louisa Forten Purvis.

books.title: Crome Yellow
books.author: Aldous Huxley
books.summary: A young writer travels to an English countryside manor to spend the summer alongside a cast of outlandish leisure class intellectuals.

books.title: Nordenholt’s Million
books.author: J. J. Connington
books.summary: After a strain of bacteria causes the collapse of the world’s food supply, a plutocrat creates a refuge to try to ensure the survival of a chosen few.

books.title: Short Fiction
books.author: Fyodor Sologub
books.summary: A collection of Fyodor Sologub’s translated short stories, ordered by date of the publication of their translation.

books.title: The Divine Comedy
books.author: Dante Alighieri
books.summary: Dante journeys through Hell, Purgatory, and Heaven in order to receive salvation and to find divine love.

books.title: South!
books.author: Ernest Shackleton
books.summary: A British expedition sets off to cross Antarctica, but when their ship is wrecked they have to face a long struggle for survival.
